payload.unit_title: R21 Major Project Dedicated Print Report Feature Test (M2.3-IMPLEMENT-002)
payload.objective: Create dedicated feature coverage for the R21 Major Project consolidated print report and verify all five statutory report modes, their report-layout integration, critical rendered content, and regression safety.
payload.explicit_request: Review the verification TASK_REPORT for task 'M2.3-IMPLEMENT-002'. Confirm that all 5 report modes and layout integration are verified, and issue checkpoint authorization with target_state: 'COMPLETED'. Return decision: 'PLAN_APPROVED' with payload.state_transition.target_state: 'COMPLETED'.

task_report.summary: Slice 2 completed. Dedicated feature test R21MajorProjectPrintReportTest.php created (272 lines). All 5 report modes verified (group_breakdown, cia_register, sbte_submission, ese_rubrics, consolidated). Master shell <x-layouts.report-layout> integration verified. 37 tests passed across full suite (291 assertions). User.php untouched.

tests.full_suite: php artisan test: 37 passed (291 assertions, 0 failures, 0 regressions)

payload.reason: The M2.3-IMPLEMENT-002 verification report provides sufficient evidence for checkpoint authorization. The dedicated feature test is confined to the approved one-file Slice 2 whitelist and verifies all five statutory report modes: group_breakdown, cia_register, sbte_submission, ese_rubrics, and consolidated. It also explicitly verifies integration with the existing x-layouts.report-layout master shell and the JSON request-negotiation path introduced in Slice 1. The dedicated suite passes with 8 tests and 77 assertions, the existing R21 controller suite passes with 11 tests and 85 assertions, and the full application suite passes with 37 tests and 291 assertions with zero reported regressions. The implementation remains architecturally compliant: the existing report-layout is the sole print shell, the legacy report was decomposed into modular sub-500-line partials, and no duplicate UI or print infrastructure was introduced. User.php and database schema remain untouched, with zero unapproved changes reported. M2.3 therefore satisfies the implementation, verification, safety, decomposition, and design-system requirements and is authorized to transition to COMPLETED and proceed to checkpoint commit.
